game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Ritual Pool, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the glyph door using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The glyph door reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the glyph door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ritual Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Ritual Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The glyph door reached with actions_used <= 22.
